title: Senior Consultant - Value, Access, and Pricing (VAP) London, Hybrid
description: We are currently seeking a hardworking, committed and intellectually curious Senior Consultant to support Trinity’s Evidence, Value, Access, and Pricing (EVAP) function. EVAP Senior Consultants fulfill a leadership role on multiple project teams, leading analysis of secondary and primary data to generate meaningful insights, while designing and implementing strategies to help our clients maintain strong growth. EVAP Senior Consultants have unique opportunities to manage project workstreams and provide mentorship to junior employees across multiple teams. With exposure to the variety of strategic business issues covered by the EVAP team, this position offers qualified candidates the opportunity to take on immediately challenging and rewarding roles. Hybrid working requirements: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home. Position Responsibilities Lead analysis of secondary and primary data to generate meaningful value, access, pricing insights and recommendations for our clients (biopharmaceutical / pharmaceutical companies), including both qualitative (e.g., IDIs, focus groups, ad-boards) and quantitative project work. Support team members both coordinating and guiding the work of more junior staff members and effectively communicating as a partner to project managers and leadership. Create and present client-ready materials, including research materials, interim deliverables, and final project reports. Train and mentor more junior staff on project case teams, in internal training efforts, and through formal / informal mentorship. Support business development activities (e.g., proposal writing) as training for future role as a BD (Business Development) lead. Support the growth of the EVAP function through involvement in internal initiatives focused on consultant’s professional development, training, resources. Position Requirements Bachelor’s degree with high academic achievement; major in health sciences, Economics, HEOR, and demonstrated interest in life sciences is a plus 3-4 years as a top performer within a top-tier biopharmaceutical / pharmaceutical strategy consulting firm serving industry leading clients Working knowledge of essential and advanced consulting methodologies, tools, and techniques Deep knowledge of key healthcare markets and archetypes (with focus on US, EU, and other HTA-oriented countries) and trends within the industry Excellent analytical skills and numeric capability Strong oral and written communication skills in English language Ability using PubMed / Medline, Google Scholar, research platforms to source reimbursement and HTA data. Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Microsoft Word, PPT, and Outlook). General understanding of systematic review methods, clinical research design, and applicable standards and regulations for clinical trials. High attention to detail with superior organizational and time management skills. Strong team player, ability to work with cross-functional staff. Ability to work under the pressure of deadlines and manage multiple priorities.

title: Associate Consultant
description: We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. The Evidence Strategy team is part of Trinity’s broader Evidence, Value, Access and Pricing (EVAP) group. Evidence Strategy provides strategic and tactical support to biotech, pharma, and medical device clients on many aspects of evidence planning, value creation and demonstration, and scientific communication through real-world health economics and outcomes research (HEOR). This individual will help clients with foundation evidence identification and synthesis from secondary sources (PubMed, Embase, etc.) to support downstream strategic evidence generation for innovative treatments and inform HEOR/RWE studies. These downstream activities may include data to support health economic models, primary research (with physicians, patients, and payers), studies including those that utilize claims, EMR, and registry data. Opportunity to be an author on peer-reviewed publications, abstracts/posters and more, based on their training, skill set and interest. This AC play a highly strategic role within the Evidence Strategy team and will have the opportunity to work closely with their peers globally as well as interaction with clients at leading Pharma, Biotech and Medical Device companies. Depending on their prior experience, they may also be responsible for employee management, project budget, training, mentoring and more. With exposure to the variety of strategic business issues covered by the Evidence, Value, Access and Pricing team, this position offers qualified candidates the opportunity to take on immediately challenging and rewarding roles, using both HEOR and Market Access lens to drive client success. Support team members as a workstream lead, both coordinating and guiding the work of more junior staff members and effectively communicating as a partner to project managers and leadership. Create and present client-ready materials, including research materials, interim deliverables, and final project reports. Provide thought leadership in evidence strategy in both client- and non-client-related activities (e.g., external conferences). Train and mentor junior staff on project teams, in internal training efforts, and through formal / informal mentorship. Lead and supports business development through creation of SLR/TLR project proposals, including ability to understand strategic client needs, design project methodology, timeline, and budget. Support the growth of the EVAP function through involvement in internal initiatives focused on consultant’s professional development, training, resources.
